messages:
alex-r: Nightly hosted-e2e turned red ~02:15 UTC. Multiple tests failing: auth handshake + streaming-toolcall flows. Noticed 401s and a few 503s. cc @eng-infra
ci-bot: Build 4357 failed. Failing tests: test_auth_handshake.py::test_kid_rotation, test_tool_invoke_streaming.py::test_tool_sequence (x4 flakes). Logs: 401 JWT verification failure (kid not found) then 503 upstream on tool invocation.
maria-p: Hmm. Are failures concentrated on specific shards?
alex-r: Mostly shard-12 and shard-7. I pasted trimmed logs below.
```
[2026-03-16T02:12:45Z] auth: verify_jwt: kid 'abc123' not found in JWKS (url=https://hosted-redwood.example/.well-known/jwks.json)
[2026-03-16T02:12:46Z] stream: handshake -> 401
[2026-03-16T02:12:47Z] tool-proxy: request -> 503 upstream timeout (connect timeout)
```
jordan-k: Could be JWKS cache TTL or a rotated signing key. Any recent deploys to hosted-auth? @devops-bot?
devops-bot: Deploy 2026-03-16T01:58 UTC: auth-service v2.4.1 rolled to hosted-east-1. No key rotations recorded in rotation log. (reacted :eyes:)
sam-l: I can reproduce locally with a small shim: set REDWOOD_JWKS_CACHE_TTL=0 then run tests — saw same kid-not-found. Suggest a quick rerun with JWKS cache disabled on the CI runner to confirm.
maria-p: Agree. Can we schedule parallel reruns on the affected shards and enable debug logs for jwks and token validation? Also request a bisect covering commits 1a2b3..7f8e9 (last-green -> main).
alex-r: Filing rerun now. devops-bot, can you kick parallel reruns with env REDWOOD_JWKS_CACHE_TTL=0 and LOG_LEVEL=debug?
devops-bot: Scheduled reruns: shards [7,12] x3 with env REDWOOD_JWKS_CACHE_TTL=0 and LOG_LEVEL=debug. Reruns queued (run ids: 789, 790, 791).
jordan-k: I'll start bisect: narrowing to PRs merged between 1a2b3 and 7f8e9. Anyone own the auth JWKS cache code? tagging @maria-p
maria-p: I touched the JWKS refresh logic in PR #4589 (merged yesterday). Happy to jump on bisect if that's likely.
sam-l: Quick note: tool-proxy timeouts may be secondary; first we need to confirm JWTs. If jwks missing then tool requests get 503 because they are rejected upstream.
alex-r: After reruns finish, paste failing logs here. If still green, we can close. If failing only when cache enabled then we have narrow repro.
ci-bot: Rerun 789 started on shard-7. ETA ~5m.
ci-bot: Rerun 789 finished: still failing test_kid_rotation with same 'kid not found' in jwks verify. run 789 logs: (snippet below).
```
[2026-03-16T02:22:11Z] auth.verify: token.kid='def456' not found, cached_jwks_keys=3, fetched_jwks_etag='W/"abc"'
[2026-03-16T02:22:12Z] http GET https://hosted-redwood.example/.well-known/jwks.json -> 200 OK (size=2.1KB)
[2026-03-16T02:22:12Z] verify_jwt: no matching key found for kid 'def456' even after fresh fetch
```
jordan-k: Looks like JWKS endpoint returning older keys or our ETag handling is wrong. Maria can you check PR #4589 behavior with If-None-Match handling?
maria-p: On it. Quick grep shows we changed If-None-Match handling to skip re-fetch on some 304/timeouts. Rolling a small patch to restore previous logic and add telemetry. Will open PR and request canary patch to auth service.
alex-r: Thanks. Assigning jordan-k for bisect, maria-p for quick patch, sam-l to monitor tests and tool-proxy spikes. I'll update the issue when patch lands.
devops-bot: Canary deploy of auth-service patch v2.4.2-cand to hosted-east-1 initiated.
ci-bot: Nightly build 4357 re-run complete: all green on affected shards. Marking as resolved for now. (reacted :tada:)
alex-r: Great. Follow-up: create an issue tracking JWKS caching test coverage and add integration that simulates key-roll. I'll file RED-1284 later today.
jordan-k: Bisect stopped early after we found the change in PR #4589. Closing bisect. PR #4595 will include revert and test.
maria-p: Filed issue RED-1284 and opened PR #4596 with the fix and added unit + integration tests. Thanks everyone.
